derivedFiles.changes: Split into native ES modules by plugin factory, shared cache state, CLI/token identity and sign-in, model catalog/usage, Connect protobuf/gzip transport, request serialization and response streaming. Preserve DevinAuthPlugin and _internal, cache and sign-in lifetimes, existing protocol/client metadata and caller-owned tool-call passthrough; do not execute upstream tools.
localChanges: CLI sign-in returns a non-secret source: devin-cli reference with the authorized real pathref and a stableAccount identity derived from existing GetUserStatus email/org/team fields, never the CLI token. Source operations reread only that file, revalidate the same account and server, and reject missing, signed-out, changed or unverifiable credentials and legacy copied-token CLI records without falling back to a saved key.

Remove token-copying homeFor credentials.toml writes and all CLI subprocess identity/model fallbacks. Keep the existing GetCliModelConfigs API/cache and known snapshot/configured model fallback; add no endpoint or remote catalog.

Loader, chat, usage and model hooks accept keyless non-api CLI source references; SDK options use a non-secret source marker and usage never sends the transient CLI key to client.auth.set. Only the plugin-initiated browser OAuth result retains a token for host-managed encrypted storage, with no local plaintext auth-file writes.

Propagate caller cancellation through CLI-source file reads and the existing GetUserStatus request while retaining its 15-second timeout, browser OAuth timeout/callback-server cleanup, and Connect stream cancellation. Add source helpers to _internal without removing its original keys.
